intro: Trump stated he opposes AI development restrictions, citing competition with China and the need to maintain American technological leadership. OpenAI will delay its IPO beyond 2026 due to safety concerns, with CEO Sam Altman calling it an "ill-advised moment to go public" amid warnings about rapid AI progress.
